title: Power MOSFET thermal analysis
content:
Hi Team,

We are looking for detailed thermal information for the STD47N10F7AG MOSFET. I am new to power MOSFET thermal analysis and would appreciate your support.

Could you please share the junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (θJA) value or any relevant thermal characterization data required for thermal calculations?

From the datasheet, I could find:

  • RθJC (Junction-to-Case) = 2.5 °C/W [st.com]
  • RθJ-PCB (Junction-to-PCB) = 50 °C/W (mounted on a 1 in² FR-4, 2 oz copper board) [st.com]

However, I could not locate the θJA specification and would like to use it for thermal analysis.

Thank you for your support.

Thanks & Regards,
Surya
